cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -0.35% · WTI -0.10% · Brent +0.39% · NatGas -1.89%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +1.22%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Power & IPPs lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.22%; weakest is Power & IPPs at -0.13%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at +3.31%
cards.body: Leaders: EOSE +3.31%, VRT +2.38%, UUUU +1.80%, RUN +1.62%, ENPH +1.42%. Laggards: DUK -0.79%, BP -0.70%, NRG -0.56%, LEU -0.40%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
